import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import os

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Explore and clean the data
print(data.info())
print(data.describe())

# Create a scatter plot to visualize the relationship between sleep duration and quality of sleep
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.scatterplot(x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', hue='Gender', data=data)
plt.title('Relationship between Sleep Duration and Quality of Sleep')
plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep (scale of 1-10)')
plt.legend(title='Gender')
plt.xticks(range(0, 12, 2))  # Limit x-axis ticks to every 2 hours

# Create a bar chart to compare the average daily steps of different BMI categories
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.barplot(x='BMI Category', y='Daily Steps', data=data)
plt.title('Average Daily Steps by BMI Category')
plt.xlabel('BMI Category')
plt.ylabel('Daily Steps (count)')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# Create a box plot to compare the heart rate of different stress levels
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.boxplot(x='Stress Level', y='Heart Rate', data=data)
plt.title('Heart Rate by Stress Level')
plt.xlabel('Stress Level')
plt.ylabel('Heart Rate (beats per minute)')
plt.xticks(range(1, 9))  # Limit x-axis ticks to every stress level

# Save the final figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Remove the plot objects
plt.clf()

# Remove the data frame
del data

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import os

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Explore and clean the data
print(data.info())
print(data.describe())

# Create a scatter plot to visualize the relationship between sleep duration and quality of sleep
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.scatterplot(x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', hue='Gender', data=data)
plt.title('Relationship between Sleep Duration and Quality of Sleep')
plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep (scale of 1-10)')
plt.legend(title='Gender')
plt.xticks(range(0, 12, 2))  # Limit x-axis ticks to every 2 hours

# Create a bar chart to compare the average daily steps of different BMI categories
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.barplot(x='BMI Category', y='Daily Steps', data=data)
plt.title('Average Daily Steps by BMI Category')
plt.xlabel('BMI Category')
plt.ylabel('Daily Steps (count)')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# Create a box plot to compare the heart rate of different stress levels
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.boxplot(x='Stress Level', y='Heart Rate', data=data)
plt.title('Heart Rate by Stress Level')
plt.xlabel('Stress Level')
plt.ylabel('Heart Rate (beats per minute)')
plt.xticks(range(1, 9))  # Limit x-axis ticks to every stress level

# Save the final figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Remove the plot objects
plt.clf()

# Remove the data frame
del data
